csv_scope_of_work: Planning and Design Services for a 50,000 s.f. building addition plus the immediate site improvements/coordination necessary to support the new building and connections to existing facility. This scope of work includes building design/professional services, all the site infrastructure, access and site improvements on the property related to the new building primarily in and around a site which extends from the existing building to an entrance drive to the east and from Judge Maney Way on the south extending to older freestanding building to the north. Currently, the parking lots and larger stormwater improvements are planned to be under a separate engineering scope of work and construction schedule that will need to be coordinated.

title: Design for Rigdon Center Addition
short_description: Design services for a 50,000-square-foot building addition and related site improvements.
project_scope: Planning and design services for a 50,000 sq ft addition to the Rigdon Center, including immediate site improvements and coordination required to support the new building and connect it to the existing facility. The site scope covers infrastructure, access, and site improvements in the area between the existing building and the entrance drive to the east, and from Judge Maney Way on the south to an older freestanding building to the north. Parking lots and larger stormwater improvements are planned under a separate engineering scope and construction schedule but must be coordinated.
services: Architecture services, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and planning/master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Medium-sized building project with approximately 50,000 sq ft new addition.
- Includes planning and design services, offering early-stage entry potential.
- Primarily an architectural/building expansion project, not a clearly complex long-span, bridge, roof, or special structure.
- Some relevance due to building scale and coordination with site infrastructure.
- Limited evidence of unusual structural complexity, innovation, or sustainability focus in the notice.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. Available scope information: 50,000 sq ft building addition with associated immediate site improvements and infrastructure coordination; parking lots and major stormwater works are excluded into a separate scope. A realistic cost estimate is not sufficiently supported by the provided notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the tender notice. The procurement is for planning and design services for a 50,000 sq ft building addition plus related site coordination, but no fee basis, percentage, or budget is stated.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and planning/master planning. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: Okaloosa County, Fort Walton Beach, Florida, USA. Contact: Derita Mason. Phone: 850-689-5960. Fax: 850-651-7551. Email: dmason@myokaloosa.com. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/myokaloosa/projects/268166
notes: Project number TDD59-26. Funding: grant. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-06-04 10:30 AM EDT at 1958 Lewis Turner Blvd, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32547, USA; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-06-10 03:00 PM EDT via online submission. Solicitation documents available online.
